name: Your Company
tagline: Made-to-measure wardrobes and cabinetry — accurate to the centimetre
niche: Custom cabinetry: sliding wardrobes, walk-in closets, kitchens, hallways

listing.description: A website for a cabinetry maker: a live wardrobe configurator with a drawing and an estimate, styled like an assembly manual — graph paper, dimension lines and a yellow marker.

seo.title: Your Company — custom wardrobes and cabinetry in Tashkent
seo.description: Sliding wardrobes, walk-in closets, kitchens and hallways made to your measurements. Price a wardrobe online, free measuring, made in 14 days, installed in Tashkent.
seo.answer: Your Company makes custom cabinetry in Tashkent, with a workshop and showroom at 28 Katartal St, open Mon–Sat 9:00–19:00. A hinged-door wardrobe starts at 2,600,000 UZS per m² of front, a sliding wardrobe at 3,100,000 UZS per m²; measuring is free, production takes 14–21 days, installation included.
